native.kind: native Linux amd64 App and exact indexed Lark worker with owned loopback Lark, TMDB, tracker and qBittorrent peers
native.environment: Native x86_64, read-only alpine:3.22, tmpfs and loopback only. The pre-existing asset slots were seeded in the fixture. No production data, credentials or message delivery.
observations: Verified ordinary Lark text searched the source TV season and the selected card sent the missing list before the search notice and resource card.

Automatic download fetched exactly one pack containing E01, E02, E04 and readme. The native qB Add used the original bytes and paused at the resolved directory. Priority zero was sent for IDs 7, 23, 99, leaving E02 ID 3 wanted, then the same hash started.
The native intent and post-Add receipt stored [2], and the Lark success template named E02. The remaining E03 produced one durable season-one R subscription and SubscribeAdded with source note [1].
The isolated App stopped. Earlier worker, site, subscriptions, movie, transfer and notification-order cases were not repeated.

prior_fixture_failures.observation: The first native setup lacked the routine qB login reply, and webhook acknowledgement was checked as a raw substring. It stopped before selection or downloader Add.
A text edit failed to apply and the same setup exited before selection. The final fixture implements the qB login reply and parses the JSON acknowledgement.

adaptations_and_open_in_scope: Native whole-season and complete-range checks remain conservative on unverifiable identities. An indivisible mixed-episode video cannot prove a request for only part of that file. The native worker requires an accepted Add with confirmed episode-file effects before counting split coverage.

This scenario verifies one season, qBittorrent and a split leaving a remainder. Whole-pack reentry, direct range, Transmission, episode-group mappings, unsupported season-zero behavior, multi-season material in one Add and cold recovery require separate evidence or further implementation.
Alternate provider chat discovery/selection, remaining subscription differences and Lark worker edge cases still keep the full plugin in implementing status.
